approach.en: Use backtracking. Start from index 0. At each step, add current subset to result. Then iterate from current index, include each element, recurse, and remove (backtrack).
approach.hi: Backtracking use karo. Index 0 se start karo. Har step par current subset result mein add karo. Phir current index se iterate karo, har element include karo, recurse karo, aur remove karo (backtrack).

code.python:
def backtrack(nums, idx, curr, result):
    result.append(curr[:])
    for i in range(idx, len(nums)):
        curr.append(nums[i])
        backtrack(nums, i + 1, curr, result)
        curr.pop()

def subsets(nums):
    result = []
    backtrack(nums, 0, [], result)
    return result

print(subsets([1, 2, 3]))

    hanoi(n - 1, aux_rod, to_rod, from_rod)

description.en: Given an m x n grid of characters board and a string word, return true if word exists in the grid. The word can be constructed from letters of sequentially adjacent cells (horizontally or vertically).
description.hi: Ek m x n character grid board aur ek string word diya gaya hai, true return karo agar word grid mein exist karta hai. Word sequentially adjacent cells (horizontally ya vertically) se construct kiya ja sakta hai.

hints.en: For each cell matching word[0], do DFS. Mark cell as visited, explore 4 directions, unmark on backtrack.
hints.hi: word[0] se match karne wale har cell ke liye DFS karo. Cell ko visited mark karo, 4 directions explore karo, backtrack par unmark karo.

approach.en: For each starting cell, run DFS. If current cell matches word[idx], mark it visited (temporarily change), recurse in 4 directions for idx+1, then restore. Return true when idx reaches word length.
approach.hi: Har starting cell ke liye DFS run karo. Agar current cell word[idx] se match karta hai, isse visited mark karo (temporarily change karo), 4 directions mein idx+1 ke liye recurse karo, phir restore karo. Jab idx word length tak pohonche tab true return karo.

solution.timeComplexity: O(m*n*4^L) where L is word length
